== General ==
[[Image:Hall of Arms.jpg|thumb|The Hall of Arms]]
The '''Hall of Arms''' is the center of dwarven military power, and houses trainers for warriors and hunters as well as several quest givers. It is located in the [[Military Ward]] in the [[dwarf]] city of [[Ironforge]].
[[Image:Hall of Arms sky exit.png|thumb|The exit the Dwarven Flying Machines use.]]
